**Bon Appétit** is a mod designed to be an alternative to popular food mods like Farmer’s Delight in order to add more diversity and strategy to food.

> The flavors in the mod do not give their effects by default; rather, you have to refine them into proper meals. The more complex and diverse the meal, the longer and stronger the effect.

> Additionally, a majority of the effects work with each other in some way, providing even more reason to experiment with different food combinations.
